definitions.gloss: seasickness; getting sick on a boat
definitions.explanation: Nausea and dizziness brought on by the motion of a boat or ship. Takes する to form the verb {船酔|ふなよ}いする, and is the sea counterpart of {車酔|くるまよ}い (carsickness).

examples.japanese: {船酔|ふなよ}い⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
{船酔|ふなよ}いしやすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{酔|よ}い{止|ど}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I get seasick easily, so I took motion-sickness medicine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧、{船酔|ふなよ}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{甲板|かんぱん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}られない→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The waves were high, and some passengers were too seasick to go out on deck.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {船酔|ふなよ}い⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to get seasick
- {船酔|ふなよ}いしやすい: to be prone to seasickness
- {船酔|ふなよ}い{止|ど}め: seasickness medicine
- ⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧{船酔|ふなよ}い: bad seasickness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{車酔|くるまよ}い→車酔い：14733_kurumayoi⟧: carsickness
- ⟦{乗|の}り{物酔|ものよ}い→乗り物酔い：25234_norimonoyoi⟧: motion sickness in general, covering any vehicle
